title: Smoky Pilaf with Crispy Potato
description: A flavorful and satisfying side dish that combines the smokiness of pilaf with the crunch of crispy potato.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced potato and cook for 5-7 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the potato from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the pilaf mix and cook according to the package instructions.
Stir in the cornstarch and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Return the crispy potato to the skillet and toss with the pilaf mixture.
